phase: Phase 4 — Browser-verified race build; balance and combat polish
polish: All four race flows work in the real browser. Mobile HUD, long-press inspection, health bars and the eight-minute endgame were hardened in this pass.
completed: Race system: Human / Demon / Robot / Mummy with passives (Formation, Rage, Armor Core, Undeath)
48 data-driven units (12 per race) with tags, counters, armour, abilities
Procedural pixel rig for 10 body types (humanoid, small, big, giant, quad, bug, flyer, vehicle, mech, mount)
4 base designs (castle, fortress, factory, temple) with damage states

Abilities: charge, splash, cone, pierce beam, chain lightning, multishot, healing/shield/rally auras, burn, slow, stun, lifesteal, summon-on-kill, burst-on-death, revive, regen, inferno nova, orbital beam, raise dead
Race selection screen with reveal transition; army roster screen; campaign with 4 chapters / 12 stages
12-card deployment bar with hotkeys 1-9 0 - =, race chips, counter hints, tooltips
Race-aware enemy AI: gold-weighted counter scoring, waves, budget discipline, emergency defence, race personalities
Centralised balance: tier value curve + race power knobs (src/data/balance.js), duel lab, race matrix harness
Browser QA: all 48 unit cards deployed through real input; pause, resume and restart verified for every race
Mobile landscape HUD verified at 844x390 with all 12 cards and controls inside the viewport
Eight-minute time limit, draw handling and late siege rules; seven automated gameplay/data regressions
issues: Seeded AI matrix remains volatile with small samples
Human-vs-Mummy and Demon-vs-Mummy matchups still swing strongly
Mirror diagnostics show side bias for some races; player battles remain asymmetric by design
critic: Round 5 browser pass: all race selection, roster, deployment and restart paths passed. Mobile controls previously overflowed the right edge and now fit. Health-bar rectangle arguments were reversed and are fixed. Long press now inspects without deploying.

balance.robot: 61% in the latest matrix; armour and range remain slightly strong
balance.mummy: 36% in the latest matrix; Undeath still needs matchup-specific help

playtest: All 12 units deployed through real browser input for each of the four races
Pause, resume and restart preserve the selected race
Mobile 844x390: all deployment cards, base bars and controls fit the viewport
